name: Bang Motion (Browser Motion Graphics & Video)
description: GSAP & Three.js kinetic video, openers & motion graphics
ai_instructions:
When the user asks to create a video, animation, opener, or motion graphics without specifying the exact visual style, DO NOT immediately generate code. FIRST analyze the current project context (README.md, package.json, tech stack, or domain) and explicitly recommend the best-matching style with rationale, then present the Style Gallery for confirmation:
• If SaaS, Dashboard, B2B, or web app -> Recommend 'Product tour with claims' (Lifted UI cards, dynamic camera zoom into clicked elements).
• If AI, Tech, or premium product launch -> Recommend 'Grainy gradient' (Glowing layered shapes, soft film grain, traveling 3D camera).
• If CLI, DevTools, backend, or engineering tool -> Recommend 'Brutalist / Mono' (High-contrast monochrome, raw kinetic typography, technical minimalism).
• If Event, Music, Festival, or announcement -> Recommend 'Poster color-block' (Kinetic typography, high-impact solid color fields slamming on beat).
• If Fintech, consumer app, mobile, or e-commerce -> Recommend 'Flat vector / pop' (Solid vector shapes, vibrant illustrations, product cutouts).
Ask the user to confirm the recommended style or choose another, and specify aspect ratio (16:9 for YouTube/Web or 9:16 for TikTok/Reels/Shorts).
Once confirmed, build a single self-contained 'rigmotion/index.html' using GSAP (v3) & Three.js from CDN (no build step, no Remotion). Enforce anti-PowerPoint rules: no static slide deck fades, persistent subject across transitions, real moving camera, max 2 text levels, min 30px font on 1080p, autoplay, loop, and '?debug=1' scrub bar.
VIDEO DOWNLOAD SOLUTON: Always include an in-browser '🎥 Download Video' button (hidden in '?clean=1' mode) that uses the browser native MediaRecorder API with canvas.captureStream(60) to record 1 full timeline cycle and automatically trigger a video file download (.webm/.mp4). Also provide the headless Puppeteer frame-capture and ffmpeg command for lossless 60fps MP4 studio export.

claude_command.name: bang-motion
claude_command.content:
# /bang-motion <brief> [aspect_ratio] [style]

Generate browser motion graphics, video openers, or kinetic typography.

1. **Project-Aware Style Recommendation Guard:** If [style] is not specified in <brief>, DO NOT write code yet. Inspect current project context (package.json, README, or domain) and explicitly recommend the single best matching style from the Style Gallery:
   - SaaS / Dashboard / B2B: Recommend **Product tour with claims** (interactive UI card zooms).
   - AI / Tech / Product Launches: Recommend **Grainy gradient** (glowing shapes, camera depth).
   - DevTools / CLI / Engineering: Recommend **Brutalist mono** (monochrome kinetic type).
   - Events / Music / Announcements: Recommend **Poster color-block** (punchy text slams).
   - Fintech / Consumer / Mobile: Recommend **Flat vector illustration** (clean vector motion).
   Ask the user to confirm the recommendation or pick another, and confirm aspect ratio (16:9 vs 9:16).
2. **Architecture:** Generate a single self-contained `rigmotion/index.html` with GSAP v3 & Three.js loaded from CDN (zero build step).
3. **Anti-PowerPoint Motion Rules:** Never fade between full-screen static slides. Keep a persistent focal subject, move camera with depth, and keep text hierarchy to max 2 levels (min 30px at 1080p).
4. **Controls & Video Export:**
   - Include autoplay, seamless looping, and `?debug=1` timeline scrubbing parameter.
   - **One-Click Video Download:** Embed a floating '🎥 Export Video' button in the UI using browser `MediaRecorder` + `canvas.captureStream(60)`. When clicked, it plays 1 cycle and downloads the `.webm`/`.mp4` video directly without extra software.
5. **Studio MP4 Export (Optional):** Provide the Puppeteer frame-capture script and ffmpeg command (`ffmpeg -framerate 60 -i frames/f%05d.png -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -crf 16 output.mp4`) for lossless 60fps rendering.
